label: Some actual concrete being is CONTINGENT_1 (exists at w, absent at some accessible world)
paraphrase: OPEN premise, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: on the route's profile, some concrete individual exists at the selected world w and is absent at some world accessible from w (CONTINGENT_1, ContingentAt: accessible non-existence, not empirical change, CONTINGENT_2). It does not say which being is contingent, that the Cogito bearer is, that it is caused, or that every being other than the root is contingent. It implies STMT-COGITO-INHABITED-CONCRETE-WORLD and excludes concrete necessitarianism (STMT-ALL-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-NECESSARY) on the same frame; the converse of that exclusion needs excluded middle.
